source: guides/GD3 section 5.5 (worked examples on cpu-8, 4 physical cores): wind wall = t_mesh 300 s + cells x iterations x 2.8 us / 4 cores + t_post 120 s, about 2 million cells and 1000 iterations on a two-storey house (1820 s, 7.6 cu); energy about 150 s for a 10-zone house at 15-minute timesteps (350 400 zone-timesteps). Acoustics and texture are PF11 placeholders. PF11c: the wind cells follow the job's quality (6, 10 or 20 cells per building side: the background mesh), the estimate counts GD3's 1000 iterations (a run that converges stops before the profile's 2000-iteration cap), and airflow (the orifice network: a container start and a fraction of a second of solving) is a small fixed estimate. The median of the last 50 succeeded jobs of a kind replaces seconds_per_unit once 50 have run.
